old_gate: Preserved FAILED. Original observed test geometries/lights are diagnostic only; no retrospective promotion.
authorization: User WL57 Gate1 Recovery and Conditional Primary Continuation. Exactly one recovery strategy and independent confirmation; automatic fixed D/R primary only on internal GO; no another recovery cycle.
diagnosis: Existing coarse spatial-pair operator SNR R/G3.5-9.1, relative change0.8-1.9%; focused action SNR diluted by spatial/angular excitation/noise. Effective stratified photons as low35358 vs125.8M overall. Local region accounts66-96% of aggregate debiased R/G action change. Full diagnostics immutable and exploratory.
strategy: Incident-field importance sampling of exact original TR.walk first exit. No full fine-K table for new confirmatory targets. No estimator/scene/model sweep.

estimator.proposal: q(source cell/bin)=mean_RGB prescribed incident flux, normalized. RGB unit path weights, multiply x/q ONLY at exit accumulation. q never uses target/geometry response. Common proposal makes same-path linearity test exact; no CRN across geometry in primary.
estimator.unbiasedness: Sum_s q_s E[exit throughput|s] x_s/q_s = Kx. Same original cell/bin sampling, homogeneous medium, RR and first-exit code. No air continuation, clipping or output normalisation. Ratio<=3 for one unit-RGB primary field.
estimator.accumulation: float64 first and exit-weight-squared moments, float32 final flux actions, importance applied after path walk; all surfaces/all64 out bins retained.

confirmation.geometry_generator: Python random.Random(578007), 4 independent tuples uniform depth[.002,.006], radius[.015,.025], centre_x/y[-.02,.02], round6decimals; first four draws fixed without any new reference outputs.
confirmation.light_distribution: Unchanged light_fields generator/test widths/kappa/families/first16 fixed-location focused population/last16 equal-E directional pairs. New seed, no selection of formerly successful fields. Same material flux on each pose.
confirmation.gate_first: Generate only first16 fields on rest+4 fresh poses, 2 replicas x2 independent32M halves. 10.24B photons. Stop if gate fails. After GO fill remaining48 fields (30.72B photons), then primary.
confirmation.separation: Original train13+val2 geometries and original96train/32val fields/targets reused exactly. Final heldout cf0..3/new64lights never in optimizer. Dedicated training_targets contains ONLY train/validation arrays, no final test outputs.

acceptance.signal: Unchanged population thresholds: SNR>=3 for >=4/16 focused fields in >=2RGB channels on>=3/4 new test poses; full global1cm/16out action vector, no local-only gate.
acceptance.variance: For each geometry/field use four independent half outputs H. Delta=mean4 H_current-mean4 H_rest. Denominator sqrt((sum_i||H_current_i-meanH_current||^2+sum_i||H_rest_i-meanH_rest||^2)/(4-1)/2), estimating pooled SINGLE64M-replica noise, rather than SE of4-half mean. Report mean-delta SE=denom/sqrt2 separately.
acceptance.noise_calibration: Pairs(half0-half1) and(half2-half3), compared with independent photon second-moment predicted trace variance. For each geometry/channel at least90% of32 focused noise-only pair norms within[.5,2] of predicted norm. No favorable fields excluded.
acceptance.physical: All halves nonnegative; energy <= prescribed input +5MC energySE+1e-6, leak/wrong side<=1e-5, zero truncation; q coverage/sum correct, no target oracle at model runtime.
acceptance.pilot: Old rest geometry and diagnostic original fields0 and48, four1M independent seeds each, compare to old2048-column two-seed means: coarse L2 difference <=2 combined normSE eachRGB, integrated flux within5 combinedSE. Same-path A/B/A+B/zero control at200k photons: superposition relativeL1<=1e-5; all physical checks pass. Pilot errors never select new confirmation fields or model capacity.
acceptance.scientific_stop: One frozen confirmation gate; failure stops. No budget/threshold/population retry based on results.

representation.passivity: analytic zero-collision B plus learned scattered response on (1-beta) input; angular/spatial conditional probabilities and sigmoid survival; no oracle at runtime, energy clamps, damping or target normalization

training.geometry_schedule: paired rest/current train geometry per step, deterministic shared order for D/R
training.optimizer: AdamW lr=.003 cosine to.00003, weight_decay1e-5, gradient norm clip1 (optimizer only)
training.loss: mean per-channel normalized action MSE: .5*(1cm,16out)+.5*(2.5mm,16out), plus .25 paired rest-to-current delta loss with denominator delta_L2^2 +(.01*rest_L2)^2
training.corrections: Only demonstrable implementation/numerical defects may be fixed with original evidence retained. No capacity growth, rank/support sweep, arbitrary retraining or alternative family after results.

gates.G1: nonnegative/passive reference, correct units/indexing/linearity; held-out aggregate edit signal/noise>=3 on>=3 of4 test poses and>=25% of their concentrated-light cases in at least2 channels. If meaningful signal cannot be resolved, stop before training, report noise. Assess independent seeds, never train on noisy individual entries.
gates.G2_G3_useful: For EACH test geometry and RGB, mean held-out relative L2 on1cm/16out<=.10 and p90<=.20; 2.5mm/16out mean<=.15; signed deformation delta relative L2<=.35 and corr>=.90 on independently detectable pose/channel cases. Report finer64bin metric and reference noise even when criteria fail.
gates.physics: zero<=1e-8, fixed-geometry linearity/superposition relative<=1e-5; no negative response (<-1e-8); analytical max column sum<=1+1e-6; repeated-cache output agreement<=1e-6; all runtime state from geometry/weights only
gates.directional: report equal-irradiance different-direction pairs against O; require differential relative L2<=.25 where O difference exceeds3seed noise. Never interpret equal total irradiance as identical input.
gates.G4_R_advantage: BOTH arms must meet useful and physics criteria. R error not worse than D by>.02 absolute relL2 on any primary geometry/channel (both seeds). R best-permitted-cache update+N query time <=.75 D on>=2 query counts including1or4; advantage exceeds timing uncertainty; cache memory<=1.25D and parameter ratio<=1.05. Else equivalence if accuracy within.02 and cost ratio[.8,1.25], otherwise conditional trade-off/no useful winner as measured.
gates.G5: Only useful+physical models enter coupled FNTO; evaluate model-vs-O, O-vs-Cycles, model-vs-Cycles separately on WL56 rest/dent near-contact scene; existing C/solve unchanged, current full scattered+ballistic bin readout plus analytic emitter; 3% physical rule not relaxed. If no model passes, skip expensive composition and report failed fidelity/validity gate, not architecture success.

cost.timing: 3 geometry/ballistic build repetitions, 5 warmups +20 query timings, CUDA fences, idle-GPU occupancy recorded; report medians and empirical intervals, all partial/full cache costs for D and R; best legitimate policy at each N; additionally 3 measured cache-build+N distinct-light lifecycle runs per policy/N; common geometry-build added separately, not hidden.
cost.scope: offline oracle/data generation and training separated from geometry update, first query, repeats and memory. No TR-to-learned speedup as R-vs-D evidence; no TransGI superiority.
cost.memory_accounting: Unique untyped-storage identity across geometry/state/coefficients/parameters, sparse indices+values included; views and aliases once; incremental and total cache allocations. Fresh process EACH model/seed/pose/cache policy; reset CUDA peak separately for cache construction, query and lifecycle; allocated/reserved and CPU RSS distinct. No geometry CPU copy used for GPU byte count.

primary.inheritance: Same class/parameter budgets, optimizer, loss,6000steps,5701/5702 and final-checkpoint evaluation. Test geometry/light population replaced prospectively; old observations remain diagnostic. No architecture changes.
primary.composition: Conditional unchanged WL56 rest/dent transfer scene, old exact O and Cycles. This is known historical transfer diagnostic, not independent confirmation. Oracle-vs-Cycles blue floor preserved; candidate-vs-O and-vs-Cycles separated.

resources.estimate: 40.96B photon maximum; existing125.8M/70s TR implies~6.4GPUh before dense-action differences, not a measured speed claim. Pilot measures runtime and actual peak; no arbitrary short universal time limit. New actions~1.9GB bundles+3.8GB halves+second moments~7.6GB; training splits~6GB; >=35GB disk margin. No full new K matrices.
resources.peak_check: Pilot peak_reserved*2+3GB <= measured GPU free; both candidates unchanged already passed A1 resident training memory smoke.
resources.safety: Detached server supervisor, exclusive locks, atomic per-half commits and checksum receipts, config/commit identities, bounded allocation fallbacks. Unknown failure halts. Never delete shared files.
